title: Letzte Generation roadblock actions at school streets
notes: ORF Wien reports three executed roadblock actions beginning around 07:45; a fourth Wiedner Hauptstraße action was prevented before implementation. Police attributed 14 participants to the blockades in total, below the 50-person threshold. The 38 administrative complaints are not a crowd count and are not arrests. The group directed climate-policy demands to the federal government, including implementation of measures such as Tempo 100. Reported blockades were resolved after about an hour; this does not establish later-week actions. This 14-person 9 January action remains below threshold. Later reporting situates daily actions across 9–13 January, but does not change this count or establish one continuous gathering; do not merge it with the distinct later-day candidates.

title: Linz electricity- and gas-price demonstration
notes: Heute reports around 40 participants at a public demonstration beginning at Taubenmarkt and marching to Linz AG. The article says 30 people and some vehicles were registered; registration is not turnout. The approximately 40 actual participants are below the threshold. No other crowd was added. The same article mentions a separate Vienna high-energy-price demonstration that day without any attendance count; that event remains a distinct pending-threshold lead.
